nativeBaseline.reference: polite live region containing transient status content with a native button close control

library: preserve one polite live-region announcement strategy without automatic focus movement
preserve native close-button activation and controlled/uncontrolled state intent boundaries
pause finite dismissal timing while pointer hover or keyboard focus remains inside a toast
consumer: author meaningful message content and accessible names for icon-only close controls
choose duration or persistent access appropriate to the importance of the content and actions
own notification queues, severity policy, history, business actions and retry behavior

notes: There is no dedicated APG Toast widget pattern; mapping uses WCAG and live-region/native-button semantics directly.
Mapping status is not a WCAG certification or a claim of spoken screen-reader output. Manual assistive-technology evidence remains pending under the repository evidence program.
